rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for energy, vigour, or lively creative force.

example.english: Even after running all day, the kid still has plenty of verve.
example.traditional: 個細路跑足成日，仲係咁有活力。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 paau2 zuk1 seng4 jat6 zung6 hai6 gam3 jau5 wut6 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on enthusiasm or passionate commitment rather than sheer energy.

example.english: Their verve for theatre drew the whole cast in.
example.traditional: 佢對舞台劇嘅熱情，令成隊人都投入晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 mou5 toi4 kek6 ge3 jit6 cing4 ling6 seng4 deoi6 jan4 dou1 tau4 jap6 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the animated spirit or expressive liveliness visible in an artist's or performer's work.

example.traditional: 佢彈琴嗰陣流露出非凡神采。
example.jyutping: keoi5 taan4 kam4 go2 zan6 lau4 lou6 ceot1 fei1 faan4 san4 coi2
